## **Financial AI®** 

Financial AI® is a full stack AI intelligence for portfolio construction, management, and creativity with proprietary realtime fundamental forecasts. By seamlessly integrating fundamentals, alternative data, and market data, it enables deep, multi-dimensional research and rigorous strategy backtesting across equities, ETFs, stock baskets, options, and crypto. Through a simple prompt interface, users can design and iterate on sophisticated investment strategies in seconds— spanning event-driven opportunities, long/short equity views, 



and macro regimes—then combine them into fully diversified, multi-asset portfolios. The result is a fluid, end-to-end workflow where ideas move effortlessly from signal to strategy to portfolio construction, powered by a single, cohesive AI system built for speed, breadth, and precision. 

## **Financial AI® Forecast Approach** 

Our Financial AI® employs over 1400+ high-quality data sources that are publicly available, including SEC filings, company fundamentals, industry metrics, many government agencies, and industry trade associations. We only use factual data and avoid sample/panel data, which usually have issues like biases from limited demographic and geographic exposure that arise in sampling errors, manipulation, and extrapolation. Even when deemed 'good' and 'relevant', a single data source alone is purely one dimensional, which can produce large errors. 

Our Financial AI® also incorporates ecosystem data. While each company presents a unique challenge due to its distinct fingerprint—shaped by its product configuration, geographic reach, and industry-specific metrics—today's companies are ever increasingly interdependent. Extensive supply chains, accelerating global reach, and growing end-market diversification contribute to a highly complex ecosystem. 

Our forecasting universe encompasses more than one thousand publicly traded U.S. companies, ranging from the small-cap, mid-cap to large-cap. Our sale forecasts' accuracy is demonstrated below calculated from the start of 2016 until 2026.
